decisions.rationale: Tall weathered post on a stone heap with three blank pointed arm boards at different heights and angles.

Crossroads signpost with three arms on a stone foot (Azure concept a, TRELLIS a-s6109). Cooked 3,940 triangles, 162,308 bytes; 3.40 m tall in a 0.80 m reach at uniform scale. Albedo 512 px with 256 px normal and ORM maps (texture memory budget), albedoGain 2.0 against TRELLIS's darkened bake. Reviewed in four views beside the 2.25 m soldier.
limitations: Arms are blank boards: no lettering or carved names.
TRELLIS invents the unseen back; it is softer than the concept view.
TRELLIS-derived: research and evaluation licence terms, no commercial clearance.
